# POLYROB owner verbs (generated)

Every slash verb the owner can send, from `core/verbs.py`. A verb runs on
every seat (Telegram and the other chat apps, the console, the terminal
REPL) unless its line says "only in …". Answer a "how do I …" question
from this list; never invent a verb that is not on it.

## talk

- `/start` — A welcome and a short tour of what I can do
- `/clear` — Clear this chat and keep my instructions (only in the terminal REPL)
- `/compact` (also /compress) — Shorten this chat's history in the background (only in the terminal REPL)
- `/history` — The turns of this chat (only in the terminal REPL)
- `/attach` — Attach local files or images to my next step (only in the terminal REPL)
- `/steer` — Give the running turn one more instruction (only in the terminal REPL)
- `/session` (also /info) — Who and where this chat is: owner, model, memory, files (only in the terminal REPL)
- `/sessions` — Every chat I know about (only in the terminal REPL)
- `/replay` — Replay a chat's feed (only in the terminal REPL)
- `/export` — Export this chat's data (only in the terminal REPL)

## needs you

- `/inbox` — Everything waiting on a decision from you, blocking first
- `/pending` — Every approval waiting on you: spends, contacts, tokens, and proposals
- `/approve` — Approve something that is waiting on you (not inside a group)
- `/reject` — Decline something that is waiting on you (not inside a group)
- `/gates` — Which actions need your approval (only in the terminal REPL)
- `/asks` — What I need from you to unblock work
- `/missed` — Messages I could not deliver live: capped, paused, or undelivered
- `/fulfill` — Mark an ask fulfilled so its work can continue (not inside a group)
- `/cards` — Open action cards: confirm a quote, answer a choice, or cancel (not inside a group)

## work

- `/goal` — Add, show, retry, pause, or stop one goal (not inside a group)
- `/goals` — The goal board summary
- `/jobs` — Scheduled jobs: next run, last outcome, and who wrote each
- `/job` — Add, change, pause, resume, run now, or stop one scheduled job (not inside a group)
- `/apps` — Deployed apps: approve an address, check health, or kill one (not inside a group)
- `/skills` — The skills I can load, and what each one does (not inside a group)
- `/learn` — Describe how to do something and I draft a skill for you to check (only in the terminal REPL)
- `/todos` — The todo list in my working files (only in the terminal REPL)
- `/subagents` — What I can hand to a helper (only in the terminal REPL)

## money

- `/book` — My ledger against every money chain: one verdict, then what disagrees
- `/wallet` — Wallet addresses, network, and spend caps; set the no-ask ceiling or trust a token
- `/invoices` — What I have billed and who owes me
- `/settle` — Mark an invoice paid
- `/trade` — Trading: start it with one decision, see it, pause, resume, stop, or release a loss stop
- `/bridge` — Move value between chains: ETH/native or USDC in; native, WETH or USDC out
- `/launch` — Launch a token on the launchpad
- `/deploy` — Deploy a fixed-supply token
- `/lp` — Liquidity positions: inspect, quote, add, remove, or collect fees
- `/claim` — Collect the creator fees a launchpad already owes me
- `/nft` — Collectibles I hold: look, trust a collection, send one, or revoke an approval
- `/dapp` — Web pages my wallet is connected to, and how to cut one off
- `/paid` — Paid room actions: status, pricing, and offers
- `/pay` — Pay for one x402 resource, up to a price you name
- `/swap` — Swap one token for another: a quote with the minimum you receive, then confirm
- `/send` — Send native value or a token to an address: a quote, then `go`
- `/writeoff` — Write a holding off: the loss is its recorded cost, and nothing is sold
- `/unquarantine` — Undo the quarantine of a look-alike holding, so it counts as open again
- `/check` — Look at any address or ticker: a wallet's holdings or a token's report

## control

- `/cancel` — Stop the task I am running now
- `/pause` — Stop autonomous work now, all of it or one scope (not inside a group)
- `/resume` — Lift the pause (not inside a group)
- `/halt` — Stop all autonomous work now (not inside a group)
- `/run` — Pause, resume or stop one background run (not inside a group)
- `/mode` — The effective autonomy posture and how to change it
- `/dev` — Message the dev and ops loop directly (not inside a group)
- `/restart` — Restart me once my current work is done (not inside a group)
- `/update` — Update me to the latest release, then report back (/update now: a waiting deploy stops waiting for your chat to go quiet) (not inside a group)
- `/autonomy` — My background loops and what they hold; switch them on or off (only in the terminal REPL)

## remember

- `/recap` — The same as /journey
- `/thread` — Our conversation across every session and rail, newest last (not inside a group)
- `/journey` — What I have done over a recent window
- `/kb` — Search and list my knowledge base
- `/memory` — Recall across sessions and inspect memory scopes (only in the terminal REPL)
- `/self` (also /soul) — My identity documents, read-only (only in the terminal REPL)

## look

- `/status` — Health first, then session, goals, loops, and wallet
- `/files` — Recent files I produced
- `/cwd` — The directory I am working in right now
- `/meter` — This turn's meter (only in the terminal REPL)
- `/contacts` — Who I have been writing to, and the transcript with one of them (not inside a group)
- `/why` — The last things I refused to do, and the reason for each (not inside a group)
- `/doctor` — The health report (only in the terminal REPL)
- `/logs` — Recent log lines of this chat (only in the terminal REPL)
- `/context` — What fills my context, slot by slot (only in the terminal REPL)
- `/steps` — The steps of the last turn (only in the terminal REPL)
- `/tools` — My abilities, built in and optional (only in the terminal REPL)
- `/telemetry` — Event counts and wallet spend across chats (only in the terminal REPL)
- `/usage` (also /cost) — What my AI use cost: by kind of work, job, model and day
- `/finance` — Income, spend, money still due and net, with my AI cost (only in the terminal REPL)

## set up

- `/allow` — Allow me to message a target (not inside a group)
- `/deny` — Revoke a message permission (not inside a group)
- `/allowlist` — Who I am allowed to message
- `/groups` — Room presence admin: allow, deny, mode, roles, and more
- `/mute` — Silence a room, or mute a member for a while
- `/ban` — Ban a member for a while
- `/unban` — Lift a member's ban
- `/unmute` — End a member's mute early
- `/config` — Read or set preferences (not inside a group)
- `/workers` — Named helpers: approve them, and stop or steer a running one (only in the terminal REPL)
- `/prefs` — The preferences you have set (not inside a group)
- `/mcp` — MCP servers I can use: add, remove, or test (not inside a group)
- `/model` — The model I run on, where that choice comes from, and how to change it (not inside a group)
- `/auth` — The provider keys I have, and how to connect one (only in the terminal REPL)
- `/persona` — The personas, and the one new chats use (only in the terminal REPL)
- `/profile` — Which Rob this terminal runs, and where its files live (only in the terminal REPL)
- `/toolset` — The ability sets, and the one new chats use (only in the terminal REPL)

## display

- `/avatar` — This instance's avatar image — show, set, clear
- `/identity` — My on-chain identity: register it, or update where it is published (spends gas) (not inside a group)
- `/quiet` — Hide or show the step transcript (only in the terminal REPL)
- `/verbose` — Show or hide the live trace (only in the terminal REPL)

## leave

- `/exit` (also /quit, /q) — Leave the terminal (only in the terminal REPL)
- `/help` (also /h, /?) — This help, or the detail for one verb
